name: Teardown mod
summary: A Teardown mod folder: a global script, a tool or a spawnable prop, with version 2 scripts that work in multiplayer.
description: A folder for Documents\Teardown\mods with info.txt and a main.lua written for script version 2, where the server part does the physics and the client part does effects and UI. It uses only models that ship with the game, so it runs before you have made a single voxel.
